threads.body:
```suggestion
          python-version: "3.15"

      # uv normally prefers interpreters it downloaded, so a fallback for
      # one scenario can take precedence over 3.15 for later scenarios.
      # Remove this step once all Python scenarios can run on 3.15.
      - name: Prefer system Python for uv
        if: matrix.language == 'python'
        run: echo "UV_PYTHON_PREFERENCE=system" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
```
